title: Sprint bridge catchup prep - Devika Sharma
body:
Context: quick sync for the sprint-bridge week (no formal sprint start until Tuesday). Catchup with report to ensure handover items, unblock technical work, and align on short-term career goals. This doc is messy — use as talking points and capture action items during the meeting.

Intent / Goals for this meeting:
- Confirm where they want to focus during the half-sprint: perf work (kv cache), infra debt, or customer debug.
- Surface any outstanding merges / PRs that need review or triage before next deploy.
- Plan on-call/rotation handover for the upcoming weekend (they're taking Sat–Sun).
- Quick career nudges: roadmap to IC3 (expectations, signals).
- Identify one measurable goal to show next week (demo / perf metric).

Agenda (30 minutes total):
1) 0-5min — Personal check-in: energy, blockers, calendar constraints. (Keep brief)
2) 5-12min — Status on top three work items: PRs, experiments, customer issues. Ask for one-sentence summary and ETA.
3) 12-20min — Deep-dive on KV cache perf experiment (if relevant): what failed, where to dig next, help needed from infra.
4) 20-26min — On-call handover checklist + runbook gaps. Confirm escalation path.
5) 26-30min — Quick career checkpoint & one action item for next week.

Prep notes for me (manager):
- KV cache: latest benchmarks in PR 187 show regressed 6–8% at 512 tokens. Devika's experiment swapped attention kernel — need to clarify baseline. Ask: did you run with same seed/scheduled batching?
- PRs pending: JIRA-5421 (customer bugfix) is blocked on infra review. Marcus is slow on infra review; propose I ping him and allocate 30m pairing.
- They mentioned 'signal noise' in telemetry for the last deploy; remind to tie a short repro to the ticket.
- Career: Devika hinted interest in leading small cross-team performance spike. Suggest concrete step: own proposal doc + demo at next eng-all-hands.

Questions to ask Devika (bullet prompts):
- What is the single highest-impact thing you can finish this week that moves your roadmap?
- What specifically do you need from me to unblock reviews or infra work? (time, PR ownership, customer context)
- Any recurring interruptions this week we should remove?
- Are there missing metrics runbooks for on-call that would make the handover smoother?

On-call handover checklist (to confirm during meeting):
- Slack rotations updated? (yes/no)
- Pager duty ownership confirmed for Sat–Sun? (Devika: confirm alias + escalation)
- Runbook link accessible: CONFLUENCE-ENG-9003 — are there any steps missing?
- Postmortem template ready? If incident occurs, commit to 48h postmortem draft.
- Hot-fix rights: do they have deploy perms for the customer-safe pool? If not, short-term workaround and owner.

Immediate action items to propose (capture owner + ETA in meeting):
- Owner: Devika — finish perf repro for KV cache with seed/logs attached; ETA: Mon 09:00.
- Owner: Marcus Li — infra review of JIRA-5421; ETA: Fri 18:00 (I will nudge).
- Owner: Devika + Aisha — update runbook step for eviction policy; ETA: Sun 12:00.
- Owner: Me (Devika's manager) — schedule 30m pairing session with Marcus and Devika to unblock infra review; ETA: Fri 10:00.

Notes capture template (I'll copy into meeting notes):
- Decision: [text]
- Blockers: [text]
- Action items: [owner] — [task] — [ETA]
- Follow-up meeting: [date/time if needed]

Career nudges (short, precise):
- Signal to IC3: lead 1 cross-team perf spike end-to-end (proposal, exec, demo).
- Measurable outcome: +X% throughput or -Yms median p50 latency on service-specific benchmark.
- Support offer: I can intro to infra-lead and sponsor time for pairing.

Raw fragments / ideas to probe if time: 
- Try hybrid kernel with quantization knob at runtime (sketch idea — needs infra ops).
- Short-term A/B fallback: keep older attention kernel as fallback for long sequences and route <512 to new one.
- Add lightweight KPI dashboard for 'deploy vs perf delta' per PR.

Post-meeting follow-up template (I'll send as slack DM + update ticket):
- Quick summary: what we decided, who owns what, ETA.
- If on-call handover occurred: add explicit escalation names + confirm deploy rights.
- Add one sentence career path note and next step (e.g., write proposal draft).

Open questions I should answer in meeting:
- Is the perf regression repeatable across region? (ask to try us-west-2 and eu-west-1)
- Any customer SLA risk if we ship current patch?
- Are there infra quotas/cost constraints that push us to delay change?

Misc scratchpad (short snippets to paste into tickets/slack):
- "Quick ask: can you review JIRA-5421 by EOW? Marcus + pairing would be ideal to unblock deploy."
- "On-call weekend: Devika (Sat–Sun). Contact Marcus Li for infra escalations; escalate to oncall-manager if P0 beyond 30m."

End — leave room to capture live notes below during the meeting.

LIVE NOTES: (fill during meeting)
- Personal check-in: ...
- Decisions: ...
- Action items: ...
